# Kev server dependencies for the pytorch -mini image (Python 3.13, linux x86_64). Every entry is pinned
# and hashed; install with `uv pip install --no-deps --require-hashes`.
#
# Source: jaredpalmer/kev uv.lock at commit 557598fced1dada75dfbf36ed144dce309ac6ceb (extra `serve`), plus
# flash-linear-attention==0.5.2 / fla-core==0.5.2 (the Gated DeltaNet kernels Qwen3.5 needs on CUDA). The
# resolved set is identical to Kev's lock apart from those additions.
#
# torch, triton and nvidia-* are deliberately ABSENT: the image's torch 2.8.0 (cu128) is used as-is, and
# --no-deps stops anything here from pulling a different torch. The manifest asserts torch is still 2.8.0
# after this install.
#
# Regenerate (see provisioning/kev/README.md):
#   uv export --frozen --no-dev --extra serve --no-emit-project   (in a Kev checkout at the pinned commit)
#   -> drop markers and mlx*, add the two fla lines, then
#   uv pip compile <in> --python-version 3.13 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --generate-hashes
#   -> drop the torch, triton and nvidia-* blocks.
